Each road `road` metres wide with `pave` of pavement, joined at the junctions by a smooth minimum `round` metres wide (a rounded kerb, not a sharp corner), inside `inside` of the middle (the edge road and beyond stay straight, their tiles the road's). Their surface is baked from the same curves (tools/import-neon.ts), the pack's asphalt `surface.y` over the pavement tiles, a `surface.cell` at a time along its edge; the kerbs traced along that edge every `trace` metres, the lamps, parked cars, flying cars, centre lines and signs laid along the curves and turned with them. The respawn `beacons` half way along four of the streets. The High City islands (`high`) have their inner face at `face`, on the Loop's outer pavement, and no back rows (no room against the edge road). The corner blocks (`low`): each block's rooms building centred `rooms.at` out on each axis; its tall one in its outer corner inside `edge` of the middle; and along both its streets a row of the `low` buildings, each turned to face its street where it stands, set back `front.setback` behind the pavement, `front.gap` apart, starting `front.from` metres out from the fork; every one kept clear of each road by its pavement, of the islands and each other by `gap`, and within `bridgeClear` of a High City bridge only if it tops out under `underBridge` (the bridge decks' undersides are at 24.9). The bridge `paths` moved out 10 m with the islands, so each end lands where it did on its island. The jump pads onto the islands' inner faces are sought from the Loop's middle (`pads.inner`). The map made of Daelonik's Neon City bundle (Phase 28, docs/PHASE_28_PLAN_THE_CENTRE_FROM_NEON_CITY.md): the owner, 2026-09-28, 'basically wiping the entire map except the idea ... implement using all new assets, nothing at all should be custom made'. `rules` are the plan's, read by tools/neon-layout.ts, which writes `chunks` (every placement: the prefab by its path under the bundle's City Builder, its pivot x, y, z in map-local metres, its turn about y in degrees, how it collides: g the ground and what lies flat on it, none, s solid to its own top a cell at a time (a building with no rooms), o its own triangles' spans (rooms, stairs, floors to walk), a pack material over all its parts where given, and the parts of it left out, by their model's file name, where given) and `tallest` and `measured`, never typed. tools/import-neon.ts NEON=bake bakes the chunks into one file a texture size and the collision off their triangles;
